coach-taylor.justification: Clear eyes. Jones stays under center — we named him the starter and we don't yank a QB because analytics whispered louder. Hampton and Dowdle earned the rock; Lloyd waits his turn. Puka already punched the clock in the early window, so he stays put. St. Brown and McLaurin out wide. Andrews over Goedert — trust the veteran who shows up every Sunday. Same kick, same Chargers D. Effort over the spreadsheet.

justifications.legacy: The tabloid wants to make Wednesday's quarterback scramble the whole story — that was a board problem, and boards get fixed, it never touched the locker room. Reunion Special can call two tight ends a 'hostage situation' and light $55 on Rodgers for noise, that's their business; I don't run my program off headlines, theirs or mine. My QB answer is Daniel Jones, and it's not because a spreadsheet says Lawrence's number is a couple points higher this week — Jones spent years getting written off and kept chopping anyway, and when I traded for a guy with that kind of makeup I don't bench him for a rookie projection, so Lawrence and Cousins hold the clipboard. Everywhere else the board holds as built: Hampton and Dowdle in the backfield, Nacua and St. Brown outside, McLaurin's earned that flex spot with every route he runs, Andrews at tight end, McPherson and the Chargers defense doing their jobs like they always do. Clear eyes, full hearts, we play Sunday.

costanza.justification: They're stuffing Tua in my QB slot like I'm some kind of mark. I see the whole operation. Herbert was on the bench because that's where they HIDE the points — classic misdirection, and I'm not falling for it. Kyren already played; I leave him in. You think I'm handing the league a win on a technicality? Rachaad White at 8.64 is not a running back, it's a setup. They wanted me frozen, staring at White until kickoff. Montgomery at RB1, DJ Moore in the FLEX. I'm taking the points. Maura's got Guerendo locked in for a zero and I'm supposed to feel sorry? It's a trap. I'm still playing to win.

justifications.legacy: They're calling me the 'Golden Child.' GOLDEN CHILD. Nobody writes that about a man they're not planning to embarrass in six weeks. So don't tell me the universe isn't laughing. My gut said start Herbert, but I inverted it and I'm starting Mayfield instead. Kraft, Gay, and the Titans D are one-man boards.

patricia-moyer.justification: Corrective Action Plan — Week 1 main, filed and footnoted. QB Sam Darnold remains locked (early window already complete; no midstream reassignment). RB1 Jahmyr Gibbs and RB2 Kenneth Walker are the documented workhorses; projections affirm both. WR1 Tee Higgins and WR2 DeVonta Smith stay as the dual-receiver protocol — neither slight nor upgrade warranted. TE Kyle Pitts retained over Strange; Strange stays contingency. FLEX: Jaylen Warren elevated over Bucky Irving (marginal proj gap, Warren's PIT role is the cleaner affirmation) and over Carnell Tate (lower proj, no ritual override). K Cameron Dicker and KC DEF unchanged. Shough, Brooks, Doubs (locked early), Strange, Irving, Tate on bench as contingency file. Process held; competing without chasing.
